note: Batch e. Hidden companies listed in programs whose OFFICIAL rule requires a current student founder, with a stated cohort year >= 2023 (a student enrolled in 2023 or later cannot have graduated before 2023): MIT delta v (rule from MIT's Orbit knowledge base) and the Georgia KickStart Fund (rule from the fund's apply page). Evidence is program rule + cohort year, not a person record. Cohorts before 2023 are excluded. SMU IIE (admits non-SMU founders), UC LAUNCH (admits alumni/faculty/staff), USF Student Innovation Incubator and Ole Miss Rebel Student Venture Fund (no cohort years; cumulative since ~2014) were considered and not used.
